title: Prime Minister shares an article by Member, NITI Aayog and Former Cabinet Secretary Shri Rajiv Gauba highlighting how PM Modi's 25 years in public office have reshaped infrastructure planning and delivery
body_text:
The Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi has shared an article written by Member, NITI Aayog and Former Cabinet Secretary, Shri Rajiv Gauba. In the article, Shri Rajiv Gauba writes that the Prime Minister's 25 years in public office have reshaped how infrastructure is planned and delivered. It highlights that moving beyond individual projects, the focus is on an integrated, citizen-centric approach that improves connectivity, ease of living and economic productivity. The Prime Minister’s Office posted on X: “Shri Rajiv Gauba, Member, NITI Aayog and Former Cabinet Secretary, writes that PM @narendramodi's 25 years in public office have reshaped how infrastructure is planned and delivered. Moving beyond individual projects, the focus is on an integrated, citizen-centric approach that improves connectivity, ease of living and economic productivity. https://indianexpress.com/article/opinion/columns/narendra-modi-gati-shakti-infrastructure-growthv-10936571/lite/ Shri Rajiv Gauba, Member, NITI Aayog and Former Cabinet Secretary, writes that PM @narendramodi's 25 years in public office have reshaped how infrastructure is planned and delivered.

Moving beyond individual projects, the focus is on an integrated, citizen-centric approach that improves connectivity, ease of living and economic productivity.
